```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(KEGGREST)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ko_table <- read.table("BO_BM_not_AR_annot.tsv", sep="\t", header=FALSE, quote="", fill=TRUE)
colnames(ko_table) <- c("KO", "Function")
head(ko_table)

```

```{r}
# Extract KO IDs
ko_list <- ko_table$KO

# Query KEGG pathway mapping
ko_to_pathway <- keggLink("pathway", "ko")


ko_list_fixed <- paste0("ko:", ko_list)

ko_path_hits <- ko_to_pathway[ko_list_fixed]
head(ko_path_hits)

# Keep only bacterial pathways (ko01100 etc. include broad metabolism)

# Convert to data frame
path_df <- data.frame(
  KO = names(ko_path_hits),
  Pathway = sub("path:", "", ko_path_hits)
)

ko_table <- data.frame(
  KO = ko_list,
  Pathway = ko_path_hits,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
ko_table <- ko_table[!is.na(ko_table$Pathway) & ko_table$Pathway != "", ]
head(ko_table, 10)


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(KEGGREST)

# ko_path_hits is a named character vector:
#   names: "ko:K00005", "ko:K00012", ...
#   values: "path:map00010", "path:map00620", ...

# Long table of all KO–pathway links
map <- stack(ko_path_hits)                    # values = Pathway, ind = ko:Kxxxxx
colnames(map) <- c("Pathway", "KO_prefixed")
map <- map %>%
  mutate(
    KO       = sub("^ko:",  "", KO_prefixed),
    Pathway  = sub("^path:","", Pathway)
  ) %>%
  select(KO, Pathway) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pathway), Pathway != "")

# Add pathway names
all_paths <- keggList("pathway")
path_names <- data.frame(
  Pathway      = sub("^path:", "", names(all_paths)),
  Pathway_Name = as.character(all_paths),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

ko_path_tbl <- map %>% left_join(path_names, by = "Pathway")
head(ko_path_tbl)

```
```{r}
pathway_summary <- ko_path_tbl %>%
  count(Pathway_Name, sort = TRUE)

head(pathway_summary, 20)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

pathway_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pathway_Name)) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Pathway_Name, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Pathways represented by BO ∩ BM (not in AR)",
    x = "KEGG pathway",
    y = "Shared KO count"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

```
```{r}
write.csv(ko_path_tbl,    "BO_BM_not_AR_KO_to_pathways.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pathway_summary,"BO_BM_not_AR_pathway_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
nrow(ko_path_tbl)        # total KO–pathway links
length(unique(ko_path_tbl$KO))   # how many of the 177 KOs mapped to ≥1 pathway
sum(is.na(ko_path_tbl$Pathway_Name))  # few or zero preferred

```
```{r}
pathway_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pathway_Name)) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Pathway_Name, n), y = n, fill = Pathway_Name)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "KEGG Pathway",
    y = "Shared KO Count"
  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

```
```{r}
library(viridis)

pathway_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pathway_Name)) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Pathway_Name, n), y = n, fill = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "D", direction = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Pathways represented by BO ∩ BM (not in AR)",
    x = "KEGG Pathway",
    y = "Shared KO Count"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

```

```{r}
# vector of shared KOs
shared_vec <- shared_BO_BM_not_AR

# background = KOs in all 3 genomes
background_vec <- unique(c(ar, bm, bo))

# create enrichment table
enrich_results <- data.frame(table(BO_BM_not_AR_annot$Pathway_Name))
colnames(enrich_results) <- c("Pathway", "Observed")

# Merge with KEGG background counts later if needed

```
```{r}
shared <- shared_BO_BM_not_AR  # length 177
background <- unique(c(bo, bm, ar))  # total universe of KOs
length(background)

library(clusterProfiler)

ekegg <- enricher(shared,
   TERM2GENE = pathway_df[, c("Pathway_ID", "KO")],
   TERM2NAME = pathway_df[, c("Pathway_ID", "Pathway_Name")],
   universe = background
)

ekegg_res <- as.data.frame(ekegg)
head(ekegg_res)


```
